reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the "Every batch lab-tested" line with the QR code, and I like that someone shows proof, but $29.99 a month is a lot when I can get magnesium at the drugstore for far less. A lab report tells me what is in the capsule, not whether I will sleep better or have fewer cramps.
objection: A lab test proves the capsule contains what it says, not that it does anything for me. For $30 a month I am paying for packaging and a creator's video, and I would forget the sachets half the time anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price, around $15 to $18 a month, or a small trial pack with a money-back guarantee so I can find out if it helps my sleep or cramps without risking $30.
